thesis: Sime offers a measured value/income purchase at 9.58x trailing earnings and a reported 5.62% yield. The bull establishes actual debt reduction and cash coverage even after the specified ordinary, NCI and sukuk distributions, without requiring another year of 32.6% core-profit growth. Only about RM53m remains under that conservative bridge, so cash discipline and cyclical exposure limit conviction.
strongest_counterexample: Reported profit fell 14.5%, Motors impairments remain material, and the approximately RM53m all-distribution surplus leaves little buffer for cyclical weakening or extra investment; management-defined core profit is not IFRS earnings.
invalidation_conditions: A comparable year with cash after fixed-asset investment, finance costs, leases and all specified distributions below zero would invalidate observed all-payout coverage.
Borrowings above the current RM6.385bn while management-defined core profit falls below RM1.55bn would undermine the funded-income thesis.
decisive_factors: Borrowings fell from RM7.122bn to RM6.385bn and the cash bridge covers current payouts.
Lower disposal gains partly explain IFRS weakness; core stability is a restrained outlook rather than guaranteed acceleration.
